title: Platform / Infrastructure Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Platform / Infrastructure Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: Linux fundamentals, container orchestration basics, scripting (Go/Python/Bash), and developer workflows.
2. Mid-level: Building internal developer platforms (IDP), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), Kubernetes operators, CI/CD runners, and telemetry collectors.
3. Senior: Self-service platform design, multi-tenant cluster isolation, cloud cost governance, developer productivity metrics (DORA metrics), and platform API design.
4. Staff-plus: Organization-wide developer platform vision, foundational compute/storage primitives, and developer velocity transformation.
